newsitem.title: USA: Price says offering to gross $37.5 million.
newsitem.headline: Price says offering to gross $37.5 million.

text.p: Price REIT Inc said Tuesday it would gross $37.5 million in the one-million share offering earlier reported today.
Price's chief financial officer George Jazek said in an interview Salomon Inc's Salomon Brothers sold one million Price shares for $37.50 a share to about 18 institutions.
Jazek added the real estate investment trust would use the proceeds to pay down its short-term credit line and ultimately to buy more properties.
The offering brings Price's outstanding shares to about 11.7 million, from 10.7 million. The trust's stock dropped 13/16 to 37-9/16 Tuesday.
